mapper.select: SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, IFNULL(u.u_name, '탈퇴한 유저') AS u_name, s.s_name, r.v_created_at, r.v_img, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_report rr WHERE rr.v_idx = r.v_idx) AS report_count FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = #{bIdx} AND r.v_parent_idx = 0 ORDER BY r.v_idx DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = #{bIdx} AND r.v_parent_idx = 0

SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, CASE WHEN r.u_idx IS NULL THEN '관리자' ELSE IFNULL(u.u_name, '탈퇴한 유저') END AS u_name, s.s_name, r.v_created_at FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE r.v_parent_idx = #{revParentIdx} ORDER BY r.v_idx ASC
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(r.v_rating), 0) FROM review r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = #{bIdx} AND r.v_parent_idx = 0 AND r.v_rating > 0

SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, IFNULL(u.u_name, '탈퇴한 유저') AS u_name, s.s_name, b.b_name, b.b_idx, r.v_created_at, r.v_img FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE r.v_parent_idx = 0 AND r.v_rating > 0 ORDER BY r.v_idx DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_report (v_idx, u_idx, rr_reason, rr_status) VALUES (#{vIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{reason}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_report WHERE v_idx = #{vIdx} AND u_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.update:
UPDATE review
v_content = #{revContent}, v_rating = #{revRating},
v_img = #{revImg},
v_updated_at = NOW()
WHERE v_idx = #{revIdx} AND u_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx LEFT JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE r.v_parent_idx = 0
AND (u.u_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR s.s_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR r.v_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
SELECT v_idx, v_img FROM review WHERE v_idx = #{revIdx}

SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, u.u_name, s.s_name, b.b_name, b.b_idx, r.v_created_at, r.v_img FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE r.u_idx = #{userIdx} AND r.v_parent_idx = 0 ORDER BY r.v_idx DESC

SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, IFNULL(u.u_name, '탈퇴한 유저') AS u_name, s.s_name, b.b_name, b.b_idx, r.v_created_at, r.v_img FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE r.v_parent_idx = 0 AND r.v_rating > 0 ORDER BY r.v_idx DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE r.v_parent_idx = 0 AND r.v_rating > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET v_content = #{content}, v_updated_at = NOW() WHERE v_idx = #{revIdx} AND u_idx IS NULL AND v_parent_idx > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (s_idx, u_idx, v_parent_idx, v_content, v_rating, v_img, v_active, v_time, v_created_at, v_updated_at) VALUES ( #{spcIdx}, #{userIdx, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{revParentIdx}, #{revContent}, #{revRating, jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{revImg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
